question:
Select the word from the options which is similar in meaning to the bracketed word given in the sentence below.

Having begun my life in a children's home I have great (empathy) with the little ones.
solution:
The correct answer is "**Affinity**."

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• In the given sentence, the speaker is saying that because they grew up in a children's home, they feel a strong connection or affinity towards young children.

 
 
• **"Empathy" means the ability to understand and share the feelings of others**.(समानुभूति)

 
 
• Example: Empathy is a quality of an emotionally strong person.
 
 
 
• **"Affinity" means a natural liking or attraction towards something or someone.**(आत्मीयता)
 
 
• Example: She had a special infinity with books.
 
 
 
 
 
• Both empathy and affinity relate to emotions and the ability to connect with others.
 
• Therefore, it can be concluded that the word "affinity" is the synonym of the word "empathy."

Hence, **the correct answer is option 3**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Apathy means lack of interest or concern towards something. (उदासीनता)
 
• Passion means strong enthusiasm or excitement towards something.(जुनून)
 
• Hostility means unfriendly or aggressive behavior towards something or someone.(शत्रुता)
